verdict.rationale: A data and scraping platform could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows only adjacent features: monitoring and data-quality validation, an MCP server that lets external agents use Actors, and loading data into Pandas for analysis. None of these is an in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
